'''Carl Hardy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Pleasanton tournament]] on 20 August 2000 with Monkey TIEs (Steven Lewis style), according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1153">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ pleasonton-ca-9-20], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 21 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-21-pleasonton-ca-9-20d1153/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
